interface.shortDescription: One brief to a reviewed PDF system design
interface.longDescription: Builds a complete PDF design report covering PRD, task map, typed contracts, workflow, architecture, model budget, FMEA, evaluations and rollout. Uses the host assistant with no extra API key, then asks whether the user wants an optional visual HTML view in the same ten-stage structure.
defaultPrompt: Use $agent-design-studio to turn this brief into a complete reviewed PDF design report and coding-agent handoff.
